title: Skin-like quasi-solid-state electrolytes for spontaneous zinc-ion dehydration toward ultra-stable zinc–iodine batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3395-3406
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05527F, Paper
Open Access

Shaochong Cao, Aiwen Zhang, Huayi Fang, Bingjian Feng, Yongshuai Liu, Pengshu Yi, Shan He, Zhouhong Ren, Longli Ma, Wenyi Lu, Mingxin Ye, Jianfeng Shen
A concept of the skin-like quasi-solid-state electrolyte (skin-QSSE) features an asymmetric structure composed of covalent organic framework (COF) nanolayers and aramid fiber hydrogel layers, advancing the development of long-life Zn–I2 batteries.
